turns.replyText:
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Here’s how to get the best results with your Mesa Loop with Covered Straw:

Before first use, wash the bottle, lid, and straw (they’re all top-rack dishwasher safe—just disassemble the lid and remove the straw and silicone plug first).
To drink, just twist in the straw and use the airflow relief valve for easy sipping—no tilting needed!
The lid has a Clean-Lock cover: click the button up or down to lock or unlock it, keeping your straw clean and leak-free.
The folding loop handle makes it easy to carry with just a finger, and it fits most cupholders for on-the-go convenience.
After each use, wash all parts and let them air dry thoroughly before storing.

If you ever need a deeper clean, you can use cleaning tablets or a vinegar and baking soda mix. Avoid microwaving or freezing the bottle.
